---
title: Meeting records
description: Read and export the record created each time a meeting assistant joins a Feishu meeting.
translation:
  source: en
  status: complete
  sourceVersion: "2026-11-18"
---

Each time a [meeting assistant](/build/meeting-assistants/) is pulled into a Feishu meeting, **Meeting records** (会议记录) adds one record. Open the record to view and export the full meeting content and the **Final report** (最终报告).

While the meeting is in progress, open **Meeting assistance** (会议协助) for the live conversation and intent detection. Switch the meeting report from that page when you need a different report.

An empty list means no bound assistant has been pulled into a Feishu meeting yet. The record is source material. It does not approve a role or an acceptance criterion.
